setup.privacyLockedDesc: Your instance is invisible to Google, Bing, and other crawlers. This protects member privacy and prevents your community from being discoverable by strangers.
setup.privacyWarningDesc: Your server name and public pages may appear in search results. Even after turning this off later, search engines may keep cached copies for weeks or months.
setup.discoveryOptInDesc: Your community will appear in the official Discovery page so others can find and join it. An admin reviews each listing before it goes public.
connect.title: LobbyForge
connect.subtitle: Connect to your self-hosted LobbyForge instance to join voice rooms and live activities.
connect.hint: Don't have an instance yet? LobbyForge is self-hosted — run it on your own server with Docker, or ask your community admin for the instance URL.
